column2: [intro]
I want to dance in the rain, sing out loud,
I want to have fun, without caring about the crowd.
I’m an artist, a dreamer with no rest,
I dive in, I laugh, I’m endlessly obsessed.
I’m diving in, I’m ready, I’ll try it all,
No limits, no regrets, I want to have a ball.
Life’s too short to hold back or delay,
I want to live it all, explore, without dismay.
I want to eat burgers for every meal,
Go skydiving, even if the ground feels unreal.
I laugh at conventions, I’m free in my spree,
And if it’s not liked, oh well, I just let it be.
No limits, no borders, I want to create,
I’m here to disrupt, to test and innovate.
The world is my playground, my canvas so wide,
I’ll go all the way, no compromise, no hide.
[ solo ]
I’m diving in, I’m ready, I’ll try it all,
No limits, no regrets, I want to have a ball.
Life’s too short to hold back or delay,
I want to live it all, explore, without dismay.
[outro]
